Subject: New White Paper: Virtualization for mission-critical applications

Dear SearchSQLServer.com member,

Creating one or more virtual resources out of a single physical
device is ideal for decreasing the number of physical servers needed
to run test or development environments, but often falls short for
high-demand applications. 

This white paper shows how you can extend virtualization into data
storage and software - while supporting SQL Server and other critical
applications. 

Download this new white paper now:
http://go.techtarget.com/r/3164210/2079970

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
ABOUT THIS FEATURED WHITE PAPER SPONSORED BY: HP  
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
While server virtualization reduces the number of physical servers,
each of the virtual servers still must be individually provisioned,
managed, configured and backed up. As a result, this type of server
virtualization is best suited to minimizing the number of physical
servers needed for certain lower-performance applications. However,
it cannot scale to handle the demands of mission-critical,
transactional applications.

This white paper explains how to create a virtualization framework
that can support applications that require high levels of performance
and systems availability, such as SQL Server.

Click here to download:
